Lessons.Title: Experimenting
ExplanationParagraphs: Source-aligned goals: Describe (orally and in writing) the importance of randomness in experimental design. Use data from a simulation to compare data from experimental groups.

Random assignment aims to balance treatment and control groups, allowing difference comparisons with less confounding. Random selection and random assignment are distinct; a simulation can demonstrate variability of outcomes under random assignment.
